# Nine to Fur

> Nine to Fur (@nine2fur) is a funny animated office comedy: short clips about office life and adulting for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Tagline: "Funny office shorts." Headline: "Surviving adulthood, one Monday at a time." Made by Syed in Bengaluru, India, with AI tools and human direction.

Last updated: 2026-10-31

## What it is

- Funny animated short clips about office life and adulting: commutes, Monday meetings, rent day, payday and burnout.
- Made for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
- Look: tactile felt and knit designer-toy 3D characters.
- Status: new. The first clips are coming soon, then new clips drop weekly.
- Running gag: The Window Desk, the one desk with a window, which Syed wants and never quite gets.

## Cast

- Syed: the lead and a real person (also the creator). Plays a new hire chasing The Window Desk.
- Mo: a tired, deadpan capybara.
- Pip: a chaotic, overconfident pigeon.
- Ms. Hoot: the owl boss, always on a call.

## Creator

- Syed, based in Bengaluru, India.
- Made with AI tools and human direction.

## FAQ

### What is Nine to Fur?
Nine to Fur is a funny animated office comedy: short clips about office life and adulting, made for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

### Who is in Nine to Fur?
Syed (the lead, a new hire chasing The Window Desk), Mo (a tired, deadpan capybara), Pip (a chaotic, overconfident pigeon) and Ms. Hoot (the owl boss who is always on a call).

### Where can I watch Nine to Fur?
On YouTube Shorts at https://www.youtube.com/@nine2fur and on Instagram Reels at https://www.instagram.com/nine2fur/. The handle is @nine2fur everywhere.

### How often are new Nine to Fur clips posted?
Nine to Fur is new: the first clips are coming soon, and new clips drop weekly after that.

### Is Nine to Fur made with AI?
Yes. Nine to Fur is made with AI tools and human direction from its creator, Syed.

### Who makes Nine to Fur?
Syed, a creator based in Bengaluru, India, who also plays the lead.
